name: Neue Dame
author: Heinrich Adolf Schmidt (Hildesheim, 1904)
description: Neue Dame ('New Draughts', Hildesheim 1904): one of the first stacking games. On the 32 dark squares of an 8x8 board a captured piece is not removed but tucked UNDER the jumper, building towers owned by whoever is on top. Men leap forward as in Anglo-American draughts; a promoted Dame flies like an International king, but her capture outranks a man's, she must take the NEAREST piece first, and she must stop on the square immediately behind the last piece taken. The winner scores one point per Dame on the board.
